Container.Name: ferret-guess-who
Container.Overview: Ferret Guess Who: a two-player Guess Who game with ferrets, played on two iPads over your home network. Open the WebUI on each iPad and use Add to Home Screen.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port the game is served on. Browse to http://UNRAID-IP:PORT on each iPad.

Config.Name: Data (ferret photos)
Config.Description: Optional. ferrets.json is copied here on first start; put photos in an images/ subfolder to override the bundled ones.
